spanish: Y dijo Jehová a Moisés: Toma a ti aromas: estacte y uña-olorosa y gálbano, aromas y incienso puro; parte en parte será.
grammarChanges: Hyphenated «uña-olorosa» (h02030034009) so the two Spanish words read as one compound substance name rather than an instrument (uña) qualified by an adjective (olorosa), matching the fail finding that the token licenses a single substance.

Kept «puro» masculine to agree with the Spanish noun «incienso» (h02030034012/013); Spanish adjective agreement follows the Spanish noun's gender, not the Hebrew noun's gender, so no change was needed to the sense of pure.
readerNote: «Uña-olorosa» was hyphenated to mark it as one substance's name, not a claw described as aromatic; «incienso puro» was kept masculine because Spanish agreement follows «incienso», not the Hebrew adjective's gender, with no change to the sense of pure.
